caption: The drawing features a rectangular frame bordered with alternating red and blue half-circles and outlined in black, brown, and blue, enclosing a central scene. Inside the frame, three identical male faces with black hair and beards are arranged side by side. Each face has closed eyes, a crown of thorns, and red marks on the forehead, cheeks, and neck that resemble wounds or drops of blood. The area beneath the faces is marked with multiple red lines extending downward, ending in red dots. Above the three faces, there is an additional rectangular arch containing a single face with a halo behind it, black hair, and closed eyes, rendered in grayscale. The upper part of the image includes a burgundy curtain with blue and gray accents, draped across the top in a semicircular manner. The background is a light tan color. The entire composition is enclosed with a thick black border.
title: Retablo
